limitations.note: The agent fixed the one-cycle output delay but removed the explicit reset check, so the outputs depend on a state transition to clear rather than responding directly to reset.
The test always drove a falling reset edge and waited for the FSM to settle before checking the outputs, so it could not expose the missing reset check when reset starts low without a state change.
The knowledge-base searches produced no task-specific guidance; the broader search only listed transcript filenames and did not inform the fix.
